prompt: GDB AArch64 SME SVG register valid values
answer:
The valid GDB AArch64 SME `SVG` register values are:

| `SVG` | Streaming vector length (`svl`) |
|---:|---:|
| 2 | 16 bytes |
| 4 | 32 bytes |
| 8 | 64 bytes |
| 16 | 128 bytes |
| 32 | 256 bytes |

These values represent the streaming vector granule (`svg`), the number of 64-bit units in `svl`.
